activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running to keep cool through the warm night
Waking up and washing: quick cool shower, brushing teeth, getting dressed
Making and eating breakfast: toast, fruit and tea, plus a large glass of water before the hot day
Packing work bag, checking phone for messages and today's program schedule
Commuting to the nonprofit office on foot and by public transport before the heat builds
Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community programs, answering emails and calls, briefing volunteers
Lunch break at an air-conditioned cafe near the office
Continuing work at the office: running a partner meeting, updating program budgets and planning next week's community events
Commuting home from the office during the peak heat
Cooking a light dinner and eating it while checking personal messages
Taking a cool shower and changing into light home clothes
Relaxing in front of the TV with the air conditioner on, scrolling on the phone
Winding down: using the computer for a bit of reading, then setting out clothes for tomorrow with the fan on
